title: The Paper Wings of Dawn
template:

With a [adverb] flick of the fingers, the first crease was formed, creating a sharp valley fold. The artist's [manual_features] moved with a grace that suggested years of dedicated practice. Every corner had to align perfectly to capture the essence of a living creature.
